intro.text: One of the eight basic Allomantic metals. An Allomancer burning it can Soothe, dampening the emotions of people nearby.

description.text: Soothing can dull someone's fatigue, fear or happiness, and Soothing every emotion but one has much the same effect as Rioting that one.
Very strong Soothing can take complete control of koloss, and once they are controlled the Soothing is no longer needed.
A Feruchemist can store warmth in brass, growing cold while filling it, and tap it to grow warm.
In the Elendel Basin, businesses are forbidden by law to use emotional Allomancy on their customers.
On Roshar, a fabrial with a brass cage weakens the fabrial's effect.
